events.body:
Fine. Put the timed request in, 10:00 to 11:00. And I want it in writing from you that the lorry is at our door at 10:15, not 'a window', not 'an hour'. We put about forty consignments a year through Corvane Arc and I've got another haulier's quote sitting on my desk. If I haven't got 10:15 guaranteed by close of play today the account moves. Simple as that.
